tool_signatures.name: scene_describe
tool_signatures.description: API-level self-description of ONE node (not spatial).

node.description: Node name (short name or long DAG path).

attrs.description: Attribute names to describe; None (default) lists every attribute listAttr reports UP TO the response budget (limit) - over-budget output is truncated and disclosed via attrs_truncated + total_count, never silent; narrow further with an explicit attrs list or raise limit and re-query. A named attr that does not exist aborts the whole call (attr_not_found) - no partial metadata (same contract as scene_export's missing_objects).

include_values.description: Also return value + soft_min/soft_max per attr (default False). Reading a value can trigger DG evaluation inside Maya - still read-only, but the eval may cost time on heavy graphs.

include_connections.description: Return connection wiring {src_plug, dst_plug, direction} (default True); the same budget applies (connections_truncated + total_connections; no cursor in v1 - narrow and re-query).

limit.description: Max items returned per face (attrs and connections). Soft default 200; a caller may relax explicitly to the hard cap 1000 (D-110) - bounds response size only, not the per-attribute query cost.

session_key.description: Maya session key (auto-selected if one session).
